column8: You are... ah.<break time="700ms"/>There you are.<break time="800ms"/>I've been watching this moment approach from very far away.<break time="600ms"/>Across Ages, across the death of stars.<break time="700ms"/>You, Potential, are standing at the fulcrum.
column9: Wonder, ancient warmth. The first thing the Antiquarian ever says to the Potential directly. Ancient voice but not tired — he has been hoping to meet this person for a very long time. The 'ah' at the top is almost a private thought he lets slip — recognition, surprise, a warmth he was not expecting to feel. 'There you are' is the warmth landing. The rest is ceremonial but still warm; never theatrical. The word 'fulcrum' at the end carries the weight of the Antiquarian's entire understanding of the Ages — do not soften it, but do not amplify either. Runs ~12 seconds at default pacing. Fires at 0:15 of the Beat J cutscene per PRELUDE_SHIP_READY_BIBLE.md §17.4 Act 2 direction. CANON: this is the same register as his 'antiq_fulcrum' / 'antiq_ages' / 'antiq_library' lines — one emotional click warmer on the opening 'ah'.
